item.title: Capstone Production Salon offers students opportunities in film production
item.description: Every semester, Columbia’s School of Film and Television kicks off with a Capstone Production Salon, an event designed to connect students with capstone film projects in need of cast and crew. item.title: Columbia must prepare students for an escalating federal enforcement reality
